entries.058efc6e4b98f4f7: An open platform service for system development companies and freelancers, operated by WhiteBox Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary of the company. Basic functions such as registering and managing the development history (skill sheets) of affiliated engineers or the freelancers themselves are free to use, while functions for 1st-tier contractors to post and propose projects in order to recruit partners and to share information about partners and engineers incur a monthly basic fee. As of the end of December 2025, 3,188 companies were registered as members, and the skill sheets of over 30,000 engineers were registered.

entries.91e878a8e8692b59: The company group, made up of the company and two consolidated subsidiaries (A.K. Plus Co., Ltd. and WhiteBox Co., Ltd.), operates a single segment, the DX Business. It consists of '0th-Order System Development', which realizes customers' DX; '0th-Order Lab', which provides solutions on a team basis; '0th-Order Consulting', which formulates strategies with development in mind; and the 'WhiteBox' platform, which realizes DX in the system development industry. entries.bafd29720206873b: This service has customer employees, the company's engineers and partners working together to resolve operational issues through system development, and it handles exclusively direct transaction projects with customers (end users). Leveraging the features of agile development (Scrum development), which allows projects to start even before requirements are fixed, the service is used in areas such as building application prototypes, system integration, smartphone app development and operation, and migrating system infrastructure to the cloud. Revenue from contracts with customers was ¥7,985 million.
